25: #define D13X_FB_BUFFERS        2u
26: #define D13X_FB_TOTAL_SIZE     (D13X_FB_FRAME_SIZE * D13X_FB_BUFFERS)
27: #define D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE   32u
28: #define D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT (64u * 1024u)
29: #define THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN   (1u << 1)

40: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache(void)
41: {
42:   uint32_t mhcr;
43: 
44:   /* The custom D13x port does not expose NuttX ARCH_DCACHE hooks, while the
45:    * E907 may inherit an enabled write-back cache from the bootloader.  Use
46:    * the vendor's numeric CSR and raw dcache.call encoding so ordinary GCC
47:    * toolchains still make framebuffer writes visible to the DE DMA master.
48:    */
49: 
50:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
51:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) != 0)
52:     {
53:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
54:       __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0010000b" ::: "memory");
55:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
56:     }
57: }
58: 
59: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache_area(const void *address, size_t row_bytes,
60:                                      size_t stride, size_t row_count)
61: {
62:   uintptr_t row;
63:   uint32_t mhcr;
64:   size_t index;
65: 
66:   if (row_bytes == 0 || row_count == 0)
67:     {
68:       return;
69:     }
70: 
71:   /* A cache-wide clean is bounded by the cache capacity and is faster than
72:    * issuing tens of thousands of per-line operations for a large redraw.
73:    */
74: 
75:   if (row_bytes * row_count >= D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT)
76:     {
77:       d13x_fb_clean_cache();
78:       return;
79:     }
80: 
81:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
82:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) == 0)
83:     {
84:       return;
85:     }
86: 
87:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence" ::: "memory");
88:   row = (uintptr_t)address;
89:   for (index = 0; index < row_count; index++)
90:     {
91:       uintptr_t current = row & ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
92:       uintptr_t end = (row + row_bytes + D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u) &
93:                       ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
94: 
95:       while (current < end)
96:         {
97:           register uintptr_t cache_address __asm__("a0") = current;
98: 
99:           /* T-Head dcache.cpa cleans one physical cache line. */
100: 
101:           __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0295000b" : "+r"(cache_address) ::
102:                                "memory");
103:           current += D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE;
104:         }
105: 
106:       row += stride;
107:     }
108: 
109:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence\n\t"
110:                        "fence.i\n\t"
111:                        ".long 0x01a0000b" ::: "memory");
112: }

157:   uint32_t x;
158:   uint32_t y;
159:   uint32_t width;

161:   uintptr_t address;
162:

171:   y = area->y;
172:   width = area->w;
173:   height = area->h;
174:   if (x >= D13X_FB_WIDTH || y >= D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS)
175:     {
176:       return -EINVAL;
177:     }
178: 
179:   if (width > D13X_FB_WIDTH - x)
180:     {
181:       width = D13X_FB_WIDTH - x;
182:     }
183: 
184:   if (height > D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS - y)
185:     {
186:       height = D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS - y;
187:     }

189:   address = (uintptr_t)g_fb.memory + y * D13X_FB_STRIDE + x * 2u;

192:                            D13X_FB_STRIDE, height);
193:   return OK;
194: }

197: static int d13x_fb_pandisplay(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
198:                               struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
199: {
200:   uintptr_t address;
201: 
202:   (void)vtable;
203: 
204:   if (pinfo == NULL || !g_fb.initialized ||
205:       (pinfo->yoffset != 0 && pinfo->yoffset != D13X_FB_HEIGHT))
206:     {
207:       return -EINVAL;
208:     }
209: 
210:   address = (uintptr_t)g_fb.memory + pinfo->yoffset * D13X_FB_STRIDE;
211: 
212:   /* LVGL uses DIRECT double buffering.  Before drawing a new dirty area it
213:    * copies the previous frame's dirty areas into the back buffer so both
214:    * framebuffers remain identical.  FBIO_UPDATE only describes the current
215:    * dirty area and therefore does not cover those synchronization copies.
216:    * Cleaning just that area can leave stale cache lines in the back buffer,
217:    * which appear as old labels and widgets after the subsequent page flip.
218:    *
219:    * Clean the complete (finite) data cache immediately before publishing the
220:    * buffer.  This makes every LVGL write visible to the DE DMA master.  It is
221:    * also cheaper than walking the entire 1.2 MiB framebuffer line by line.
222:    */
223: 
224:   d13x_fb_clean_cache();
225:   d13x_de_set_framebuffer(address);
226:   return OK;
227: }

241:   return ret;
242: }

334: static int fbdev_init_mem2(lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc)
335: {
336:     uintptr_t buf_offset;
337:     struct fb_planeinfo_s pinfo;
338:     int ret;
339: 
340:     lv_memzero(&pinfo, sizeof(pinfo));
341: 
342:     /* Get display[1] planeinfo */
343: 
344:     pinfo.display = dsc->pinfo.display + 1;
345: 
346:     if((ret = fbdev_get_pinfo(dsc->fd, &pinfo)) < 0) {
347:         return ret;
348:     }
349: 
350:     /* Check bpp */
351: 
352:     if(pinfo.bpp != dsc->pinfo.bpp) {
353:         LV_LOG_WARN("mem2 is incorrect");
354:         return -EINVAL;
355:     }
356: 
357:     /* Check the buffer address offset,
358:      * It needs to be divisible by pinfo.stride
359:      */
360: 
361:     buf_offset = pinfo.fbmem - dsc->mem;
362: 
363:     if((buf_offset % dsc->pinfo.stride) != 0) {
364:         LV_LOG_WARN("It is detected that buf_offset(%" PRIuPTR ") "
365:                     "and stride(%d) are not divisible, please ensure "
366:                     "that the driver handles the address offset by itself.",
367:                     buf_offset, dsc->pinfo.stride);
368:     }
369: 
370:     /* Calculate the address and yoffset of mem2 */
371: 
372:     if(buf_offset == 0) {
373:         dsc->mem2_yoffset = dsc->vinfo.yres;
374:         dsc->mem2 = pinfo.fbmem + dsc->mem2_yoffset * pinfo.stride;
375:         LV_LOG_USER("Use consecutive mem2 = %p, yoffset = %" LV_PRIu32,
376:                     dsc->mem2, dsc->mem2_yoffset);
377:     }
378:     else {
379:         dsc->mem2_yoffset = buf_offset / dsc->pinfo.stride;
380:         dsc->mem2 = pinfo.fbmem;
381:         LV_LOG_USER("Use non-consecutive mem2 = %p, yoffset = %" LV_PRIu32,
382:                     dsc->mem2, dsc->mem2_yoffset);
383:     }

257: void lv_inv_area(lv_display_t * disp, const lv_area_t * area_p)
258: {
259:     if(!disp) disp = lv_display_get_default();
260:     if(!disp) return;
261:     if(!lv_display_is_invalidation_enabled(disp)) return;
262: 
263:     /**
264:      * There are two reasons for this issue:
265:      *  1.LVGL API is being used across threads, such as modifying widget properties in another thread
266:      *    or within an interrupt handler during the main thread rendering process.
267:      *  2.User-customized widget modify widget properties/styles again within the DRAW event.
268:      *
269:      * Therefore, ensure that LVGL is used in a single-threaded manner, or refer to
270:      * documentation: https://docs.lvgl.io/master/porting/os.html for proper locking mechanisms.
271:      * Additionally, ensure that only drawing-related tasks are performed within the DRAW event,
272:      * and move widget property/style modifications to other events.
273:      */
274:     LV_ASSERT_MSG(!disp->rendering_in_progress, "Invalidate area is not allowed during rendering.");
275: 
276:     /*Clear the invalidate buffer if the parameter is NULL*/
277:     if(area_p == NULL) {
278:         disp->inv_p = 0;
279:         return;
280:     }
281: 
282:     lv_area_t scr_area;
283:     scr_area.x1 = 0;
284:     scr_area.y1 = 0;
285:     scr_area.x2 = lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(disp) - 1;
286:     scr_area.y2 = lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp) - 1;
287: 
288:     lv_area_t com_area;
289:     bool suc;
290: 
291:     suc = lv_area_intersect(&com_area, area_p, &scr_area);
292:     if(suc == false)  return; /*Out of the screen*/
293: 
294:     if(disp->color_format == LV_COLOR_FORMAT_I1) {
295:         /*Make sure that the X coordinates start and end on byte boundary.
296:          *E.g. convert 11;27 to 8;31*/
297:         com_area.x1 &= ~0x7; /*Round down: Nx8*/
298:         com_area.x2 |= 0x7;    /*Round up: Nx8 - 1*/
299:     }
300: 
301:     /*If there were at least 1 invalid area in full refresh mode, redraw the whole screen*/
302:     if(disp->render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_FULL) {
303:         disp->inv_areas[0] = scr_area;
304:         disp->inv_p = 1;
305:         lv_display_send_event(disp, LV_EVENT_REFR_REQUEST, NULL);
306:         return;
307:     }
308: 
309:     lv_result_t res = lv_display_send_event(disp, LV_EVENT_INVALIDATE_AREA, &com_area);
310:     if(res != LV_RESULT_OK) return;
311: 
312:     /*Save only if this area is not in one of the saved areas*/
313:     uint16_t i;
314:     for(i = 0; i < disp->inv_p; i++) {
315:         if(lv_area_is_in(&com_area, &disp->inv_areas[i], 0) != false) return;
316:     }
317: 
318:     /*Save the area*/
319:     lv_area_t * tmp_area_p = &com_area;
320:     if(disp->inv_p >= LV_INV_BUF_SIZE) { /*If no place for the area add the screen*/
321:         disp->inv_p = 0;
322:         tmp_area_p = &scr_area;
323:     }
324:     lv_area_copy(&disp->inv_areas[disp->inv_p], tmp_area_p);
325:     disp->inv_p++;
326: 
327:     lv_display_send_event(disp, LV_EVENT_REFR_REQUEST, NULL);
328: }

348: void lv_display_refr_timer(lv_timer_t * tmr)
349: {
350:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
351:     LV_TRACE_REFR("begin");
352: 
353:     if(tmr) {
354:         disp_refr = tmr->user_data;
355:         /* Ensure the timer does not run again automatically.
356:          * This is done before refreshing in case refreshing invalidates something else.
357:          * However if the performance monitor is enabled keep the timer running to count the FPS.*/
358: #if !LV_USE_PERF_MONITOR
359:         lv_timer_pause(tmr);
360: #endif
361:     }
362:     else {
363:         disp_refr = lv_display_get_default();
364:     }
365: 
366:     if(disp_refr == NULL) {
367:         LV_LOG_WARN("No display registered");
368:         return;
369:     }
370: 
371:     lv_draw_buf_t * buf_act = disp_refr->buf_act;
372:     if(!(buf_act && buf_act->data && buf_act->data_size)) {
373:         LV_LOG_WARN("No draw buffer");
374:         return;
375:     }
376: 
377:     lv_display_send_event(disp_refr, LV_EVENT_REFR_START, NULL);
378: 
379:     /*Refresh the screen's layout if required*/
380:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN_TAG("layout");
381:     lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->act_scr);
382:     if(disp_refr->prev_scr) lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->prev_scr);
383: 
384:     lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->bottom_layer);
385:     lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->top_layer);
386:     lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->sys_layer);
387:     LV_PROFILER_END_TAG("layout");
388: 
389:     /*Do nothing if there is no active screen*/
390:     if(disp_refr->act_scr == NULL) {
391:         disp_refr->inv_p = 0;
392:         LV_LOG_WARN("there is no active screen");
393:         goto refr_finish;
394:     }
395: 
396:     lv_refr_join_area();
397:     refr_sync_areas();
398:     refr_invalid_areas();
399: 
400:     if(disp_refr->inv_p == 0) goto refr_finish;
401: 
402:     /*If refresh happened ...*/
403:     lv_display_send_event(disp_refr, LV_EVENT_RENDER_READY, NULL);
404: 
405:     /*In double buffered direct mode save the updated areas.
406:      *They will be used on the next call to synchronize the buffers.*/
407:     if(lv_display_is_double_buffered(disp_refr) && disp_refr->render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_DIRECT) {
408:         uint32_t i;
409:         for(i = 0; i < disp_refr->inv_p; i++) {
410:             if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[i])
411:                 continue;
412: 
413:             lv_area_t * sync_area = lv_ll_ins_tail(&disp_refr->sync_areas);
414:             *sync_area = disp_refr->inv_areas[i];
415:         }
416:     }
417: 
418:     lv_memzero(disp_refr->inv_areas, sizeof(disp_refr->inv_areas));
419:     lv_memzero(disp_refr->inv_area_joined, sizeof(disp_refr->inv_area_joined));
420:     disp_refr->inv_p = 0;
421: 
422: refr_finish:
423: 
424: #if LV_DRAW_SW_COMPLEX == 1
425:     lv_draw_sw_mask_cleanup();
426: #endif
427: 
428:     lv_display_send_event(disp_refr, LV_EVENT_REFR_READY, NULL);
429: 
430:     LV_TRACE_REFR("finished");
431:     LV_PROFILER_END;
432: }

438: /**
439:  * Join the areas which has got common parts
440:  */
441: static void lv_refr_join_area(void)
442: {
443:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
444:     uint32_t join_from;
445:     uint32_t join_in;
446:     lv_area_t joined_area;
447:     for(join_in = 0; join_in < disp_refr->inv_p; join_in++) {
448:         if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[join_in] != 0) continue;
449: 
450:         /*Check all areas to join them in 'join_in'*/
451:         for(join_from = 0; join_from < disp_refr->inv_p; join_from++) {
452:             /*Handle only unjoined areas and ignore itself*/
453:             if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[join_from] != 0 || join_in == join_from) {
454:                 continue;
455:             }
456: 
457:             /*Check if the areas are on each other*/
458:             if(lv_area_is_on(&disp_refr->inv_areas[join_in], &disp_refr->inv_areas[join_from]) == false) {
459:                 continue;
460:             }
461: 
462:             lv_area_join(&joined_area, &disp_refr->inv_areas[join_in], &disp_refr->inv_areas[join_from]);
463: 
464:             /*Join two area only if the joined area size is smaller*/
465:             if(lv_area_get_size(&joined_area) < (lv_area_get_size(&disp_refr->inv_areas[join_in]) +
466:                                                  lv_area_get_size(&disp_refr->inv_areas[join_from]))) {
467:                 lv_area_copy(&disp_refr->inv_areas[join_in], &joined_area);
468: 
469:                 /*Mark 'join_form' is joined into 'join_in'*/
470:                 disp_refr->inv_area_joined[join_from] = 1;
471:             }
472:         }
473:     }
474:     LV_PROFILER_END;
475: }

477: /**
478:  * Refresh the sync areas
479:  */
480: static void refr_sync_areas(void)
481: {
482:     /*Do not sync if not direct or double buffered*/
483:     if(disp_refr->render_mode != LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_DIRECT) return;
484: 
485:     /*Do not sync if not double buffered*/
486:     if(!lv_display_is_double_buffered(disp_refr)) return;
487: 
488:     /*Do not sync if no sync areas*/
489:     if(lv_ll_is_empty(&disp_refr->sync_areas)) return;
490: 
491:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
492:     /*With double buffered direct mode synchronize the rendered areas to the other buffer*/
493:     /*We need to wait for ready here to not mess up the active screen*/
494:     wait_for_flushing(disp_refr);
495: 
496:     /*The buffers are already swapped.
497:      *So the active buffer is the off screen buffer where LVGL will render*/
498:     lv_draw_buf_t * off_screen = disp_refr->buf_act;
499:     lv_draw_buf_t * on_screen = disp_refr->buf_act == disp_refr->buf_1 ? disp_refr->buf_2 : disp_refr->buf_1;
500: 
501:     uint32_t hor_res = lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(disp_refr);
502:     uint32_t ver_res = lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr);
503: 
504:     /*Iterate through invalidated areas to see if sync area should be copied*/
505:     uint16_t i;
506:     int8_t j;
507:     lv_area_t res[4] = {0};
508:     int8_t res_c;
509:     lv_area_t * sync_area, * new_area, * next_area;
510:     for(i = 0; i < disp_refr->inv_p; i++) {
511:         /*Skip joined areas*/
512:         if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[i]) continue;
513: 
514:         /*Iterate over sync areas*/
515:         sync_area = lv_ll_get_head(&disp_refr->sync_areas);
516:         while(sync_area != NULL) {
517:             /*Get next sync area*/
518:             next_area = lv_ll_get_next(&disp_refr->sync_areas, sync_area);
519: 
520:             /*Remove intersect of redraw area from sync area and get remaining areas*/
521:             res_c = lv_area_diff(res, sync_area, &disp_refr->inv_areas[i]);
522: 
523:             /*New sub areas created after removing intersect*/
524:             if(res_c != -1) {
525:                 /*Replace old sync area with new areas*/
526:                 for(j = 0; j < res_c; j++) {
527:                     new_area = lv_ll_ins_prev(&disp_refr->sync_areas, sync_area);
528:                     *new_area = res[j];
529:                 }
530:                 lv_ll_remove(&disp_refr->sync_areas, sync_area);
531:                 lv_free(sync_area);
532:             }
533: 
534:             /*Move on to next sync area*/
535:             sync_area = next_area;
536:         }
537:     }
538: 
539:     lv_area_t disp_area = {0, 0, (int32_t)hor_res - 1, (int32_t)ver_res - 1};
540:     /*Copy sync areas (if any remaining)*/
541:     for(sync_area = lv_ll_get_head(&disp_refr->sync_areas); sync_area != NULL;
542:         sync_area = lv_ll_get_next(&disp_refr->sync_areas, sync_area)) {
543:         /**
544:          * @todo Resize SDL window will trigger crash because of sync_area is larger than disp_area
545:          */
546:         lv_area_intersect(sync_area, sync_area, &disp_area);
547:         lv_draw_buf_copy(off_screen, sync_area, on_screen, sync_area);
548:     }
549: 
550:     /*Clear sync areas*/
551:     lv_ll_clear(&disp_refr->sync_areas);
552:     LV_PROFILER_END;
553: }

555: /**
556:  * Refresh the joined areas
557:  */
558: static void refr_invalid_areas(void)
559: {
560:     if(disp_refr->inv_p == 0) return;
561:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
562: 
563:     /*Find the last area which will be drawn*/
564:     int32_t i;
565:     int32_t last_i = 0;
566:     for(i = disp_refr->inv_p - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
567:         if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[i] == 0) {
568:             last_i = i;
569:             break;
570:         }
571:     }
572: 
573:     /*Notify the display driven rendering has started*/
574:     lv_display_send_event(disp_refr, LV_EVENT_RENDER_START, NULL);
575: 
576:     disp_refr->last_area = 0;
577:     disp_refr->last_part = 0;
578:     disp_refr->rendering_in_progress = true;
579: 
580:     for(i = 0; i < (int32_t)disp_refr->inv_p; i++) {
581:         /*Refresh the unjoined areas*/
582:         if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[i] == 0) {
583: 
584:             if(i == last_i) disp_refr->last_area = 1;
585:             disp_refr->last_part = 0;
586:             refr_area(&disp_refr->inv_areas[i]);
587:         }
588:     }
589: 
590:     disp_refr->rendering_in_progress = false;
591:     LV_PROFILER_END;
592: }

610: /**
611:  * Refresh an area if there is Virtual Display Buffer
612:  * @param area_p  pointer to an area to refresh
613:  */
614: static void refr_area(const lv_area_t * area_p)
615: {
616:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
617:     lv_layer_t * layer = disp_refr->layer_head;
618:     layer->draw_buf = disp_refr->buf_act;
619: 
620: #if LV_DRAW_TRANSFORM_USE_MATRIX
621:     lv_matrix_identity(&layer->matrix);
622: #endif
623: 
624:     /*With full refresh just redraw directly into the buffer*/
625:     /*In direct mode draw directly on the absolute coordinates of the buffer*/
626:     if(disp_refr->render_mode != LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_PARTIAL) {
627:         layer->buf_area.x1 = 0;
628:         layer->buf_area.y1 = 0;
629:         layer->buf_area.x2 = lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(disp_refr) - 1;
630:         layer->buf_area.y2 = lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr) - 1;
631:         lv_area_t disp_area;
632:         lv_area_set(&disp_area, 0, 0, lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(disp_refr) - 1,
633:                     lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr) - 1);
634: 
635:         if(disp_refr->render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_FULL) {
636:             disp_refr->last_part = 1;
637:             layer_reshape_draw_buf(layer, layer->draw_buf->header.stride);
638:             layer->_clip_area = disp_area;
639:             layer->phy_clip_area = disp_area;
640:             refr_area_part(layer);
641:         }
642:         else if(disp_refr->render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_DIRECT) {
643:             disp_refr->last_part = disp_refr->last_area;
644:             layer_reshape_draw_buf(layer, layer->draw_buf->header.stride);
645:             layer->_clip_area = *area_p;
646:             layer->phy_clip_area = *area_p;
647:             refr_area_part(layer);
648:         }
649:         LV_PROFILER_END;
650:         return;
651:     }
652: 
653:     /*Normal refresh: draw the area in parts*/
654:     /*Calculate the max row num*/
655:     int32_t w = lv_area_get_width(area_p);
656:     int32_t h = lv_area_get_height(area_p);
657:     int32_t y2 = area_p->y2 >= lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr) ?
658:                  lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr) - 1 : area_p->y2;
659: 
660:     int32_t max_row = get_max_row(disp_refr, w, h);
661: 
662:     int32_t row;
663:     int32_t row_last = 0;
664:     lv_area_t sub_area;
665:     for(row = area_p->y1; row + max_row - 1 <= y2; row += max_row) {
666:         /*Calc. the next y coordinates of draw_buf*/
667:         sub_area.x1 = area_p->x1;
668:         sub_area.x2 = area_p->x2;
669:         sub_area.y1 = row;
670:         sub_area.y2 = row + max_row - 1;
671:         layer->draw_buf = disp_refr->buf_act;
672:         layer->buf_area = sub_area;
673:         layer->_clip_area = sub_area;
674:         layer->phy_clip_area = sub_area;
675:         layer_reshape_draw_buf(layer, LV_STRIDE_AUTO);
676:         if(sub_area.y2 > y2) sub_area.y2 = y2;
677:         row_last = sub_area.y2;
678:         if(y2 == row_last) disp_refr->last_part = 1;
679:         refr_area_part(layer);
680:     }
681: 
682:     /*If the last y coordinates are not handled yet ...*/
683:     if(y2 != row_last) {
684:         /*Calc. the next y coordinates of draw_buf*/
685:         sub_area.x1 = area_p->x1;
686:         sub_area.x2 = area_p->x2;
687:         sub_area.y1 = row;
688:         sub_area.y2 = y2;
689:         layer->draw_buf = disp_refr->buf_act;
690:         layer->buf_area = sub_area;
691:         layer->_clip_area = sub_area;
692:         layer->phy_clip_area = sub_area;
693:         layer_reshape_draw_buf(layer, LV_STRIDE_AUTO);
694:         disp_refr->last_part = 1;
695:         refr_area_part(layer);
696:     }
697:     LV_PROFILER_END;
698: }

700: static void refr_area_part(lv_layer_t * layer)
701: {
702:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
703:     disp_refr->refreshed_area = layer->_clip_area;
704: 
705:     /* In single buffered mode wait here until the buffer is freed.
706:      * Else we would draw into the buffer while it's still being transferred to the display*/
707:     if(!lv_display_is_double_buffered(disp_refr)) {
708:         wait_for_flushing(disp_refr);
709:     }
710:     /*If the screen is transparent initialize it when the flushing is ready*/
711:     if(lv_color_format_has_alpha(disp_refr->color_format)) {
712:         lv_area_t a = disp_refr->refreshed_area;
713:         if(disp_refr->render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_PARTIAL) {
714:             /*The area always starts at 0;0*/
715:             lv_area_move(&a, -disp_refr->refreshed_area.x1, -disp_refr->refreshed_area.y1);
716:         }
717: 
718:         lv_draw_buf_clear(layer->draw_buf, &a);
719:     }
720: 
721:     lv_obj_t * top_act_scr = NULL;
722:     lv_obj_t * top_prev_scr = NULL;
723: 
724:     /*Get the most top object which is not covered by others*/
725:     top_act_scr = lv_refr_get_top_obj(&layer->_clip_area, lv_display_get_screen_active(disp_refr));
726:     if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
727:         top_prev_scr = lv_refr_get_top_obj(&layer->_clip_area, disp_refr->prev_scr);
728:     }
729: 
730:     /*Draw a bottom layer background if there is no top object*/
731:     if(top_act_scr == NULL && top_prev_scr == NULL) {
732:         refr_obj_and_children(layer, lv_display_get_layer_bottom(disp_refr));
733:     }
734: 
735:     if(disp_refr->draw_prev_over_act) {
736:         if(top_act_scr == NULL) top_act_scr = disp_refr->act_scr;
737:         refr_obj_and_children(layer, top_act_scr);
738: 
739:         /*Refresh the previous screen if any*/
740:         if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
741:             if(top_prev_scr == NULL) top_prev_scr = disp_refr->prev_scr;
742:             refr_obj_and_children(layer, top_prev_scr);
743:         }
744:     }
745:     else {
746:         /*Refresh the previous screen if any*/
747:         if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
748:             if(top_prev_scr == NULL) top_prev_scr = disp_refr->prev_scr;
749:             refr_obj_and_children(layer, top_prev_scr);
750:         }
751: 
752:         if(top_act_scr == NULL) top_act_scr = disp_refr->act_scr;
753:         refr_obj_and_children(layer, top_act_scr);
754:     }
755: 
756:     /*Also refresh top and sys layer unconditionally*/
757:     refr_obj_and_children(layer, lv_display_get_layer_top(disp_refr));
758:     refr_obj_and_children(layer, lv_display_get_layer_sys(disp_refr));
759: 
760:     draw_buf_flush(disp_refr);
761:     LV_PROFILER_END;
762: }

764: /**
765:  * Search the most top object which fully covers an area
766:  * @param area_p pointer to an area
767:  * @param obj the first object to start the searching (typically a screen)
768:  * @return
769:  */
770: static lv_obj_t * lv_refr_get_top_obj(const lv_area_t * area_p, lv_obj_t * obj)
771: {
772:     lv_obj_t * found_p = NULL;
773: 
774:     if(lv_area_is_in(area_p, &obj->coords, 0) == false) return NULL;
775:     if(lv_obj_has_flag(obj, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN)) return NULL;
776:     if(lv_obj_get_layer_type(obj) != LV_LAYER_TYPE_NONE) return NULL;
777: 
778:     /*If this object is fully cover the draw area then check the children too*/
779:     lv_cover_check_info_t info;
780:     info.res = LV_COVER_RES_COVER;
781:     info.area = area_p;
782:     lv_obj_send_event(obj, LV_EVENT_COVER_CHECK, &info);
783:     if(info.res == LV_COVER_RES_MASKED) return NULL;
784: 
785:     int32_t i;
786:     int32_t child_cnt = lv_obj_get_child_count(obj);
787:     for(i = child_cnt - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
788:         lv_obj_t * child = obj->spec_attr->children[i];
789:         found_p = lv_refr_get_top_obj(area_p, child);
790: 
791:         /*If a children is ok then break*/
792:         if(found_p != NULL) {
793:             break;
794:         }
795:     }
796: 
797:     /*If no better children use this object*/
798:     if(found_p == NULL && info.res == LV_COVER_RES_COVER) {
799:         found_p = obj;
800:     }
801: 
802:     return found_p;
803: }

805: /**
806:  * Make the refreshing from an object. Draw all its children and the youngers too.
807:  * @param top_p pointer to an objects. Start the drawing from it.
808:  * @param mask_p pointer to an area, the objects will be drawn only here
809:  */
810: static void refr_obj_and_children(lv_layer_t * layer, lv_obj_t * top_obj)
811: {
812:     /*Normally always will be a top_obj (at least the screen)
813:      *but in special cases (e.g. if the screen has alpha) it won't.
814:      *In this case use the screen directly*/
815:     if(top_obj == NULL) top_obj = lv_display_get_screen_active(disp_refr);
816:     if(top_obj == NULL) return;  /*Shouldn't happen*/
817: 
818:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
819:     /*Refresh the top object and its children*/
820:     refr_obj(layer, top_obj);
821: 
822:     /*Draw the 'younger' sibling objects because they can be on top_obj*/
823:     lv_obj_t * parent;
824:     lv_obj_t * border_p = top_obj;
825: 
826:     parent = lv_obj_get_parent(top_obj);
827: 
828:     /*Do until not reach the screen*/
829:     while(parent != NULL) {
830:         bool go = false;
831:         uint32_t i;
832:         uint32_t child_cnt = lv_obj_get_child_count(parent);
833:         for(i = 0; i < child_cnt; i++) {
834:             lv_obj_t * child = parent->spec_attr->children[i];
835:             if(!go) {
836:                 if(child == border_p) go = true;
837:             }
838:             else {
839:                 /*Refresh the objects*/
840:                 refr_obj(layer, child);
841:             }
842:         }
843: 
844:         /*Call the post draw function of the parents of the to object*/
845:         lv_obj_send_event(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST_BEGIN, (void *)layer);
846:         lv_obj_send_event(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST, (void *)layer);
847:         lv_obj_send_event(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST_END, (void *)layer);
848: 
849:         /*The new border will be the last parents,
850:          *so the 'younger' brothers of parent will be refreshed*/
851:         border_p = parent;
852:         /*Go a level deeper*/
853:         parent = lv_obj_get_parent(parent);
854:     }
855:     LV_PROFILER_END;
856: }

858: static lv_result_t layer_get_area(lv_layer_t * layer, lv_obj_t * obj, lv_layer_type_t layer_type,
859:                                   lv_area_t * layer_area_out, lv_area_t * obj_draw_size_out)
860: {
861:     int32_t ext_draw_size = lv_obj_get_ext_draw_size(obj);
862:     lv_obj_get_coords(obj, obj_draw_size_out);
863:     lv_area_increase(obj_draw_size_out, ext_draw_size, ext_draw_size);

924:     lv_point_t pivot = {

930:     pivot.y = obj->coords.y1 + lv_pct_to_px(pivot.y, lv_area_get_height(&obj->coords));
931: 
932:     int32_t rotation = lv_obj_get_style_transform_rotation(obj, 0);
933:     int32_t scale_x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_scale_x(obj, 0);
934:     int32_t scale_y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_scale_y(obj, 0);
935:     int32_t skew_x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_skew_x(obj, 0);
936:     int32_t skew_y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_skew_y(obj, 0);

938:     if(scale_x <= 0 || scale_y <= 0) {
939:         /* NOT draw if scale is negative or zero */
940:         return;
941:     }

943:     /* generate the obj matrix */
944:     lv_matrix_translate(&obj_matrix, pivot.x, pivot.y);
945:     if(rotation != 0) {
946:         lv_matrix_rotate(&obj_matrix, rotation * 0.1f);
947:     }
948: 
949:     if(scale_x != LV_SCALE_NONE || scale_y != LV_SCALE_NONE) {
950:         lv_matrix_scale(
951:             &obj_matrix,
952:             (float)scale_x / LV_SCALE_NONE,
953:             (float)scale_y / LV_SCALE_NONE
954:         );
955:     }
956: 
957:     if(skew_x != 0 || skew_y != 0) {
958:         lv_matrix_skew(&obj_matrix, skew_x, skew_y);
959:     }
960: 
961:     lv_matrix_translate(&obj_matrix, -pivot.x, -pivot.y);
962: 
963:     /* apply the obj matrix */
964:     lv_matrix_multiply(&layer->matrix, &obj_matrix);
965: 
966:     /* calculate clip area without transform */
967:     lv_matrix_t matrix_reverse;
968:     lv_matrix_inverse(&matrix_reverse, &obj_matrix);
969: 
970:     lv_area_t clip_area = layer->_clip_area;
971:     lv_area_t clip_area_ori = layer->_clip_area;
972:     clip_area = lv_matrix_transform_area(&matrix_reverse, &clip_area);
973: 
974:     /* increase the clip area by 1 pixel to avoid rounding errors */
975:     if(!lv_matrix_is_identity_or_translation(&obj_matrix)) {
976:         lv_area_increase(&clip_area, 1, 1);
977:     }
978: 
979:     layer->_clip_area = clip_area;
980: 
981:     /* redraw obj */
982:     lv_obj_redraw(layer, obj);
983: 
984:     /* restore original matrix */
985:     layer->matrix = ori_matrix;
986:     /* restore clip area */
987:     layer->_clip_area = clip_area_ori;

1122:     tmp.x2 = 0;
1123:     tmp.y1 = 0;

1125:     int32_t h_tmp = max_row;
1126:     do {

最准确的当前结论是：在用户列出的候选点中，没有一处能被现有静态源码单独“确定”为同页文字旧像素残留的根因。可以确定存在的是 VSYNC wait 的竞态和错误处理不闭环；它是最强的时序嫌疑，但不是已经被代码级证明的像素内容错误。cache clean、DIRECT sync-area、FBIO_UPDATE 的地址换算以及合法双缓冲 pan 顺序，反而都有当前源码或 luban-lite 参考支持。要把嫌疑升级为定案，必须在板端记录每帧的 buf_act、FBIO_UPDATE area/yoffset、FBIOPAN_DISPLAY yoffset、FBIO_WAITFORVSYNC 返回值、pan queue count，以及 DE UI_RECT_ADDR 在 VSYNC 前后的值；同时对残留矩形做 CPU 读回并与两页 framebuffer 比较，才能区分“CPU buffer 已旧”“cache 未写回”“DE 仍扫旧页”三类情况。
